note: This file is a unit test module (test_models.py) containing only unittest.TestCase subclasses for testing JSON serialization/deserialization of OCP API client data models. It has no standalone callable functions, CLI entry points, or externally usable APIs. All classes are test fixtures that require pytest/unittest to run.
test_Model_serde: test the Model data model JSON serialization and deserialization round-trip
test_Atoms_to_ase_atoms: test the Atoms model conversion to ASE Atoms objects with constraints
test_AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsRequest_ser: test the AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsRequest model JSON serialization with all fields
test_AdsorbateSlabRelaxationResult_to_as: test the AdsorbateSlabRelaxationResult conversion to ASE Atoms with energy and forces
test_Slab_serde: test the Slab model JSON serialization including nested atoms and metadata
